title: Brent spikes -> short CCL 2d at 1d lag
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Brent log-return spikes hit cruise names contemporaneously (r=-0.30 at lag 0) with no reversal at 1-4d; test whether the drop continues: trade short CCL 2d at 1d lag (-) [finance.BZ=F.log_return -> finance.CCL.log_return]
message: Brent spike (z20>1) -> short CCL next day: r=-0.30 at lag 0 (n=390), rule hit 52% (50 trades, avg +0.37%, OOS 62.5%/16), sharpe-like 0.94, max DD -18.6%; weak, contemporaneous effect, no strong 1d continuation

trade_idea.entry_rule: finance.BZ=F.log_return rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short CCL next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Brent spike -> short CCL 1d gave hit 52% (OOS 62.5%, n=16) with rule capped at 1d hold; test whether the 2-3 day continuation exists by targeting royal caribbean instead: Brent log-return z>1 -> short RCL for 3 days at 1d lag (-) [finance.BZ=F.log_return -> finance.RCL.log_return] (parent: R2-0175)
